name: burnzombies
description: Computer-wide observation and guarded cleanup of abandoned agent helpers on macOS.
long_description: Computer-wide process evidence, guarded graceful stops and verified impact through MCP. Use the single-command installer to enable the independent background observer and its selected harness reviewer; this MCP bundle alone provides interactive tools. Native macOS 14+, Apple Silicon/Intel. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

tools.name: burnzombies_status
tools.description: Read process-family counts, pressure and receipts.

tools.name: burnzombies_inspect
tools.description: Inspect bounded live process evidence.

tools.name: burnzombies_preview
tools.description: Preview agent-selected identities with ownership rationale.

tools.name: burnzombies_burn
tools.description: Request guarded SIGTERM for a fresh preview.

tools.name: burnzombies_checkpoint
tools.description: Quiet cached-signal lifecycle callback; never stops processes.

tools.name: burnzombies_lifecycle
tools.description: Remember active helper ownership and owner-observed completion; never stops a process.

tools.name: burnzombies_work
tools.description: Read durable lifecycle evidence across tasks without exposing ownership tokens.

tools.name: burnzombies_workspace
tools.description: Register, release or inspect explicitly disposable workspaces.

tools.name: burnzombies_workspace_preview
tools.description: Preview owner-released worktree cleanup with preservation checks.

tools.name: burnzombies_workspace_clean
tools.description: Clean a supported worktree using a fresh guarded preview.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_decide
tools.description: Save advice for an exact disk candidate without removing files.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_inspect
tools.description: Inspect compact storage, producer and optional Mole evidence.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_explore
tools.description: Queue deeper local storage measurements without keeping a model running.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_evidence
tools.description: Read bounded source, build or retention evidence in a measured branch.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_recommend
tools.description: Save one practical storage recommendation without granting deletion permission.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_preview
tools.description: Preview an explicitly approved regenerable folder.

tools.name: burnzombies_disk_clean
tools.description: Remove only the exact freshly previewed folder under native guards.

tools.name: burnzombies_owner_preview
tools.description: Preview one exact supported idle producer for owner-mediated retirement.

tools.name: burnzombies_owner_stop
tools.description: Request authenticated stop-when-idle for a fresh exact producer preview.

tools.name: burnzombies_cache_preview
tools.description: Preview exact eligible local BuildKit cache records under retention and allowance guards.

tools.name: burnzombies_cache_clean
tools.description: Request owner-managed GC of exact freshly previewed cache records.

tools.name: burnzombies_worktrees
tools.description: Inspect worktrees, record managed-work ownership and completion, and request guarded clean retirement under explicit policy. Never adopts or purges through a model.
